title: Canon EOS 5D Mark IV Digital SLR Camera USA Warranty - Bundle with 64GB U3 SDHC Card, Holster Case, Table Top Tripod, Cleaning Kit, Memory Wallet, Screen Protector, Card Reader, Mac Software Package
description: The EOS 5D Mark IV camera builds on the powerful legacy of the 5D series, offering amazing refinements in image quality, performance and versatility. Canon's commitment to imaging excellence is the soul of the EOS 5D Mark IV. Wedding and portrait photographers, nature and landscape shooters, as well as creative videographers will appreciate the brilliance and power that the EOS 5D Mark IV delivers. Superb image quality is achieved with Canon's all-new 30.4 Megapixel full-frame sensor, and highly-detailed 4K video is captured with ease. Focus accuracy has been improved with a refined 61-point AF system and Canon's revolutionary Dual Pixel CMOS AF for quick, smooth AF for both video and Live View shooting. Fast operation is enhanced with Canon's DIGIC 6+ Image Processor, which provides continuous shooting at up to 7.0 fps. Built-in Wi-Fi, GPS and an easy-to-navigate touch-panel LCD allow the camera to become an extension of you. When quality matters, the EOS 5D Mark IV helps deliver results to inspire even the most discerning imagemaker. 30.4 Megapixel Full-frame CMOS Sensor The EOS 5D Mark IV camera boasts a full-frame, high-speed CMOS sensor that's ideal for a broad range of applications with its remarkable high-resolution abilities. Measuring approximately 36.0mm x 24.0mm, the same size and ratio as a 35mm film frame, it records 30.4 effective Megapixels at normal ISOs of up to 32000. It also captures incredible still and 4K video clips suitable for significant post-processing, retouching and cropping. Versatile in virtually all kinds of light and any shooting situation from print and wedding to full-bleed magazine spreads and other commercial or fine art use, the EOS 5D Mark IV consistently produces high-resolution 4K video and image files that are easily compatible with any number of diverse workflows. ISO 100-32000 (expandable to 50-102400) Featuring an ISO range of 100-32000 (expandable to 50-102400), the EOS 5D Mark IV camera is incredibly well-suited for low-light photography. Its sensor has an improved S/N ratio plus an improved noise-processing algorithm to help deliver high-level light sensitivity along with its high resolution, with virtually no compromise in image quality. Whether working in a dimly lit auditorium, trying to capture the action at night, photographing at the fastest possible shutter speed or simply suppressing camera shake blur, the EOS 5D Mark IV has an extended ISO range that contributes to its ability to excel in nearly every situation it faces. 4K Motion JPEG video (DCI cinema-type 4096 x 2160) at 30p or 24p; in-camera still frame grab of 4K 8.8-Megapixel images; multiple video options include Full HD up to 60p, and HD up to 120p. The EOS 5D Mark IV is a remarkably capable video camera. Thanks to its impressive CMOS sensor and its high-speed DIGIC 6+ Image Processor, it can transition from taking still photographs to shooting videos in a near instant, capturing Digital Cinema (DCI) standard 4K (Motion JPEG) videos of 4096 x 2160 pixels at up to 30 or 24 fps. Adding to its versatility, it also supports the 4K broadcasting standard of 3840 x 2160 pixels with slight trimming on the left and right sides. Superb Dual Pixel CMOS AF for responsive and smooth AF during video or Live View shooting; LCD monitor has full touch-screen interface, including selection of AF area. Adding to its powerful and portable design, the EOS 5D Mark IV camera utilizes Canon's smooth, fast and intelligent Dual Pixel CMOS AF. Featuring two photodiodes per pixel and each pixel capable of phase-difference detection autofocus, the CMOS sensor can deliver fast and accurate AF throughout approximately 80% of the image plane. Able to detect shifts in movement at the pixel level, Dual Pixel CMOS AF enables continuous automatic AF and AF tracking that enhances overall camera operation for sharp still images and smooth, accurate focus transitions in movies. Dual Pixel CMOS AF Adding to its powerful and portable design, the EOS 5D Mark IV camera utilizes Canon's smooth, fast and intelligent Dual Pixel CMOS AF. Featuring two photodiodes per pixel and each pixel capable of phase-difference detection autofocus, the CMOS sensor can deliver fast and accurate AF throughout approximately 80% of the image plane. Able to detect shifts in movement at the pixel level, Dual Pixel CMOS AF enables continuous automatic AF and AF tracking that enhances overall camera operation for sharp still images and smooth, accurate focus transitions in movies. Working with the EOS 5D Mark IV's 3.2" touch panel LCD screen, Dual Pixel CMOS AF lets photographers select focus points throughout the frame with the touch of a finger, and confirm focus by zooming in on the image or enlarging stills grabbed from video recordings. 3.2" Touch Panel LCD The EOS 5D Mark IV camera features a 1.62 million dot, low-reflection 3.2-inch Clear View LCD II monitor for bright, sharp display in a wide variety of shooting situations. The LCD's touch panel surface facilitates fast, intuitive operation, including AF frame switching, menu and setting changes plus image magnification during Live View shooting and movie shooting. Still photographs can also be captured quickly with the touch panel's shutter release function. A customizable Quick Control screen adds flexibility and convenience for specific users' preferences. Image review and playback are also enhanced with the EOS 5D Mark IV camera's Clear View LCD II Monitor. Not only does the EOS 5D Mark IV's LCD provide a high-precision image for composition and playback, but it also remains visible even when the photographer is wearing polarized sunglasses! In numerous situations in the studio and in the field, the EOS 5D Mark IV's LCD panel is an ideal complement to its amazing TTL viewfinder. reviews.title: Outstanding high resolution DSLR
reviews.content: I purchased this camera body to use as a second camera for use in the field to be able to quickly switch between my long lens and my medium range zoom. To be clear, both of my camera bodies are now the EOS 5D Mark 4 and my selection of getting a second identical one is based on my experience with the first. This is a great camera!!

reviews.title: Yes it's still relevant in 2026! Best landscape, street & travel Pro cam with built in GPSat this price range!
reviews.content: I was frustrated to use the app version GPS with my Leica LUMIX and Other cameras, despite having many cameras of all made I regret selling my MK4 years go and bought 2 in 2026! reviews.title: EOS 5D Mark IV Body
reviews.content: Purchased the 5D Mk 4 body because it will be the last of 5D series. Have 2 already and they are truly great work horses!  Easier to work with and more dependable then the mirrorless models!

reviews.title: Still an amazing camera
reviews.content: I bought this camera a little over a year ago and I love it. This camera is a tank. I love the sound of the shutter.  The pictures are immaculate and I can crop with no pixels. It feels great in the hand, its weight helps keep the shot steady. The view finder is bright and a real life view. No lag. I hate electric viewfinders. They are terrible. I have a mirrorless camera and can't stand the delay when I pull it up to my eyes. There is an ocean of lenses available for this. I know mirror-less is the direction many manufacturers are going. I hope Canon continues to make DSLR alternative as time goes on.  It's a great camera if you're on the fence. If you're not shooting video this will suit you. I shoot a on of film as well.  I own A EOS 1n & EOS 3.  All great cameras and it's great to have lenses that work across the board. I wish Canon would have made RF backwards compatible. That would've been fun.

reviews.title: Canon 5d mark iv
reviews.content: Fast shipping on a great camera. This is my second body in this model after using my original for several years.

reviews.title: My Two Thumbs Say....
reviews.content:
During the Spring of this year, 2024, I bought a new EOS 5D Mark IV from Camera Mall in Ann Arbor, MI. I went on line and saw they had them in stock, so I paid for it in advance and then jumped in my car and drove over 55 miles to pick it up. The thought of owning this camera body was exciting because I'd read so many good things about it, especially since earlier this year in March, I met a professional that was shooting with a 1D. I told him my best camera is a Canon 6D and wondered if the 5D Mark IV was significantly better. He animately said yes! and that I would notice a major difference. After this statement and having read other reviews, I was game to take a chance, especially since I'm not not interested in switching to mirrorless, not even with an adapter. Besides, that's what a cell phone's set up is, right? Plus, I own a Canon SX40 HS bridge camera and a Ricoh-Pentax WG-4 pocket camera. Neither are DSLR but I'm good with those and would rather concentrate on the old mirror DSLR community of photography.
Well, I must say I've had nothing but good things and experiences with this apparatus, even though I paid $500.00 more than the advertised current sale price. My evaluative opinion may not be the best; I consider myself a novice professional. For me, it's just an addictive hobby but I have been paid for my photography (unsolicited) and some of my pictures have been featured in a newspaper. I've paired my shooting with 5 different Canon L lenses and based off of other reviews I've read here on the Canon website, I may be adding the EF 24-70 2.8 L to my lens collection.
So far, I'd say this body has performed well and I'm glad I bought it while the getting is not as good as the RF mirrorless mounts.
My two thumbs say Yes! This camera is well worth the ownership!

reviews.title: Blurry pictures.
reviews.content: Purchased and tried for 7 days.  Tried every setting I could find and could not take crisp sharp photos.  Used tripod and shutter release.  Contacted Canon, no help.  I suspect the low pass filter is the culprit.  Returned camera.  Disappointed with Canon.  Have EOS 5D Mark III and am very pleased.

title: Antelope Audio Zen Quadro Synergy Core Portable 14x10 Dual USB-C Audio Interface
description: With the Zen Quadro Synergy Core Portable 14x10 Dual USB-C Audio Interface, you can experience the pinnacle of modern audio technology in a compact, portable form. This bus-powered audio interface boasts 14-in/10-out connectivity, Discrete preamps, and class-leading converters, all enhanced by real-time DSP+FPGA effects. The Zen Quadro Synergy Core is a game-changer for creators, musicians, and streamers alike, integrating top-tier components from Antelope Audio's flagship Galaxy range. Its console-grade Discrete preamps with 75dB gain deliver the same high-quality sound that the world's top recording studios enjoy. The interface's revolutionary dual-USB design allows simultaneous playback and recording on two systems, offering unparalleled flexibility for your production setup. Its AD/DA converters, boasting up to 130dB dynamic range at 24-bit/192 kHz, outperform competitors at several times the cost. The Zen Quadro's four Discrete preamps, inspired by the British and American analog console designs of the eighties and nineties, offer maximum noise reduction and precise sound capture. With extremely low noise and up to 75dB of gain, this interface can handle even the quietest dynamic and ribbon mics. The Synergy Core technology combines DSP with FPGA chips to model each component of analog hardware, delivering sound and behavior that's virtually indistinguishable from the real thing. This technology allows for near-zero latency and zero strain on your computer's CPU. The Zen Quadro comes with 37 legendary compressors, EQs, guitar amps and cabs, modulation effects, and more, all of which can be applied in real-time during recording, streaming, or live performances. You can load up to 48 mono effect instances on 6 input chains simultaneously, putting the power of a complex multi-rack setup on your desktop. The Zen Quadro's dual USB-C ports unlock a new world of possibilities for creators. You can freely route signals and create mixes between the two USB connections, using Mac, PC, iOS (USB-C), or Android devices together. The convenient loopback makes it great for streaming, and the secondary port can charge your mobile device while the primary port provides power for the Zen Quadro. The Zen Quadro Synergy Core Portable 14x10 Dual USB-C Audio Interface offers enhanced standalone functionality for live and touring. With complete standalone operation, you can easily access routing and mixer controls through the color display, and recall settings and real-time FX chains, making it ideal for live performances. The interface offers flexible connectivity for your entire studio, with four mic/line inputs, two instrument inputs, ADAT input, and S/PDIF I/O. You can record a total of up to 14 inputs simultaneously. The second headphone out has an independent mixer, so 2 people can listen to different cue mixes at the same time. The DC-coupled I/O can also send and receive control voltage (CV) signals, allowing the Zen Quadro to be part of a modular synth setup. In summary, the Zen Quadro Synergy Core Portable 14x10 Dual USB-C Audio Interface offers class-leading AD/DA conversion, proprietary 64-bit AFC (Acoustically Focused Clocking) technology, and a host of workflow-enhancing features. It comes with a collection of 37 Synergy Core effects modeled after classic and rare analog outboard gear, and allows for real-time effects processing with near-zero latency.
